changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Accept the duplicate version reason without scanning the event ledger while it is locked.
changeSet.sql: SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'; ALTER TABLE item_event DROP CONSTRAINT ck_item_event_reason, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_item_event_reason CHECK (reason IS NULL OR reason IN ('GATE_WITHHELD', 'COOLDOWN_ACTIVE', 'REQUEST_COOLDOWN_ACTIVE', 'REQUESTER_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED', 'CONCURRENT_DUPLICATE', 'COALESCED', 'OUT_OF_REVIEW_SCOPE', 'BOT_AUTHOR', 'BOT_REVIEWER', 'STALE_ROLLOUT_REVISION', 'WORKSPACE_INACTIVE', 'PRACTICES_DISABLED', 'NO_ACTIVE_PRACTICE', 'REVIEW_MODEL_UNBOUND', 'MEMBER_AI_DECLINED', 'PERSON_DATA_ERASED', 'FEEDBACK_MODE_OFF', 'SUBJECT_UNLINKED', 'MERGE_ACTOR_UNAVAILABLE', 'MODEL_UNAVAILABLE', 'BUDGET_EXHAUSTED', 'ITEM_NOT_VISIBLE', 'VERSION_SUPERSEDED', 'PENDING_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED', 'ITEM_GONE', 'LEGACY_REVIEW_UNBOUND', 'OCCASION_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE', 'QUIET_WINDOW', 'REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS', 'ALREADY_CURRENT', 'DUPLICATE_VERSION')) NOT VALID

rollback.sql: SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'; ALTER TABLE item_event DROP CONSTRAINT ck_item_event_reason, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_item_event_reason CHECK (reason IS NULL OR reason IN ('GATE_WITHHELD', 'COOLDOWN_ACTIVE', 'REQUEST_COOLDOWN_ACTIVE', 'REQUESTER_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED', 'CONCURRENT_DUPLICATE', 'COALESCED', 'OUT_OF_REVIEW_SCOPE', 'BOT_AUTHOR', 'BOT_REVIEWER', 'STALE_ROLLOUT_REVISION', 'WORKSPACE_INACTIVE', 'PRACTICES_DISABLED', 'NO_ACTIVE_PRACTICE', 'REVIEW_MODEL_UNBOUND', 'MEMBER_AI_DECLINED', 'PERSON_DATA_ERASED', 'FEEDBACK_MODE_OFF', 'SUBJECT_UNLINKED', 'MERGE_ACTOR_UNAVAILABLE', 'MODEL_UNAVAILABLE', 'BUDGET_EXHAUSTED', 'ITEM_NOT_VISIBLE', 'VERSION_SUPERSEDED', 'PENDING_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED', 'ITEM_GONE', 'LEGACY_REVIEW_UNBOUND', 'OCCASION_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE', 'QUIET_WINDOW', 'REVIEW_IN_PROGRESS', 'ALREADY_CURRENT'))
